'''Imbuing''' is the action of temporarily boosting an equipment item using [[Astral Sources]] which are usually expensive (eg. rope belt). Imbuements can be applied to any item with ''imbuement slots'', but each imbuement is only available for a particular set of items or item types.

The imbuing system was first presented to players as a [[Dev Notes|Dev Note]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3680|August 18, 2016}}.

__TOC__

== Mechanics ==
Imbuements can be applied to a [[#Imbuable Items|limited set of items]] which have imbuement slots. The type of imbuements available depends on the item. Generally, the item's type will determine which imbuements are permitted; however, there are exceptions to this rule: for example, [[Rod of Destruction|Rod]] and [[Wand of Destruction]] can have imbuements that are unavailable to most rods and wands. The table of imbuements below provides a general guide to which type of items can accept each imbuement. An item with multiple imbuement slots can have multiple distinct imbuements, but may not have the same type of imbuement applied to the item. For example, an item imbued with [[Basic Electrify]] cannot have [[Intricate Electrify|Intricate]] or [[Powerful Electrify]] applied to it in its other imbuement slots, and at the same time, the weapon with Basic Electrify cannot be imbued with any level of another elemental damage imbuement like [[Reap]], [[Venom]], etc.

The imbuement bonuses available are elemental damage, elemental protection, [[skill]] boosts (including [[speed]]), [[Critical Hit|critical hit]], [[Hit Points Leech|hit points leech]], [[Mana Leech|mana leech]], extra [[Capacity]] and [[Paralysis]] deflection. Items with an initial elemental damage, or a positive or negative elemental protection or skill boost cannot be imbued with the respective imbuements.

Each imbuement lasts for 20 hours of use, after which the item loses the imbuement. Imbuements can be reapplied to an item that has lost its imbuement. Whether an imbuement is in use or not depends on the type of imbuement, in particular:
* Non-combat imbuements, such as speed- or capacity-boosting imbuements, are in use while the item is equipped.
* Combat imbuements are active while the item is equipped and the player is in combat.
** "In combat" means that the wielder has been in combat. Note that the absence of the [[Logout Block]] does not indicate being out-of-combat, because being in a [[Protection Zone]] merely hides the [[Logout Block]].

== Imbuement Process ==

To imbue an item, you need to follow these steps:

* Complete the first part of the [[Forgotten Knowledge Quest]] to unlock the first two levels of each imbuement. Please note that additional quests are required to unlock the third and most powerful imbuement.
* Gather the [[Creature Products]] required for the desired imbuement.
* Visit an [[Imbuing Shrine]] and use it on the item you want to imbue.
* Confirm the imbuing process by confirming the applicable gold fee and selected imbuement.

=== Gold Fees ===

* Basic Imbuement: 7,500 gold
* Intricate Imbuement: 60,000 gold
* Powerful Imbuement: 250,000 gold
* Clearing Imbument: 15,000 gold

=== Account Types ===

In regards to account types:

* Free accounts can only perform basic imbuements upon completing the first part of the quest. To use powerful and intricate imbuements Free account players can use [[Imbuing#Imbuement_Scrolls|Imbuement Scrolls]].
* Premium accounts, upon completing the first part of the quest, can perform both basic and intricate imbuements. In addition, once further quests have been completed, premium accounts can unlock the ability to perform powerful imbuements.

=== Additional Considerations ===

When preparing for the imbuing process, please consider the following:

* Ensure you have the required gold and creature products available in your character's inventory, stash, or bank.
* The imbuing process will first consume the creature products and gold from your inventory. If there is not enough creature products or gold in your inventory, it will then draw from the stash and or bank.

== List of Imbuements ==
The game offers 24 accessible and utilizable imbuements for players. However, there are 3 additional imbuements existing in the game files that are not actively used or accessible. 

The following tables list the available imbuements:
=== Attack Imbuements ===
[[Melee]] Weapons as well as two-handed [[Distance Weapons]] (i.e. Bows and Crossbows) that are imbued with elemental attack will deal damage at a fixed percentage along with the remaining Physical damage. 
* Usually, melee weapons with native elemental damage cannot be imbued with elemental imbuements. The mechanic is quite simple with melee weapons, as every hit will split the damage between the physical and elemental damage and then the target's sensibilities and resistances to said damage will be applied.
* Instead, imbued Distance weapons work differently: The imbuement is applied to the Bow/Crossbow when the total damaged is calculated with the bow's/crossbow's hit rate and attack modifier along with the fired ammunition's attack value and hit rate, then the damage is reduced or increased by the target's sensibilities and resistances. Finally, the elemental damage imbuement will not work with area ammunition such as [[Diamond Arrow|Diamond]] and [[Burst Arrow]]s nor native-elemental ammunition, such as [[Envenomed Arrow|Envenomed]] and [[Flash Arrow]]s. Still, the imbuement's time will be consumed.

== Unlocking Powerful Imbuements ==

Basic imbuements can be applied by all players upon completing the first part of the Forgotten Knowledge Quest. To add intricate imbuements to items, players need to have a Premium Account and complete the first part of the quest. Powerful imbuements are unlocked via completing additional quests or defeating specific bosses, as listed below:

* [[Powerful Reap]], [[Powerful Lich Shroud|Lich Shroud]] – defeating [[Lady Tenebris]];
* [[Powerful Cloud Fabric]], [[Powerful Electrify|Electrify]], [[Powerful Swiftness|Swiftness]], [[Powerful Punch|Punch]] – defeating [[Lloyd]];
* [[Powerful Snake Skin]], [[Powerful Venom|Venom]], [[Powerful Bash|Bash]], [[Powerful Slash|Slash]], [[Powerful Chop|Chop]] – defeating [[The Enraged Thorn Knight]];
* [[Powerful Scorch]], [[Powerful Dragon Hide|Dragon Hide]] – defeating [[Soul of Dragonking Zyrtarch]];
* [[Powerful Frost]], [[Powerful Quara Scale|Quara Scale]], [[Powerful Blockade|Blockade]] – defeating [[Melting Frozen Horror]];
* [[Powerful Demon Presence]], [[Powerful Precision|Precision]] – defeating [[The Time Guardian]];
* [[Powerful Vampirism]] – defeating [[Lady Tenebris]] or completing the [[Heart of Destruction Quest]];
* [[Powerful Void]] – defeating [[Soul of Dragonking Zyrtarch]] or completing the [[Heart of Destruction Quest]];
* [[Powerful Strike]], [[Powerful Epiphany|Epiphany]] – defeating [[The Last Lore Keeper]] or completing the [[Heart of Destruction Quest]];
* [[Powerful Featherweight]] – completing the [[Dangerous Depths Quest]];
* [[Powerful Vibrancy]] – completing [[The Dream Courts Quest]].

== Imbuement Scrolls ==
All powerful and intricate imbuements are available as [[Imbuement Scroll]]. Imbuement Scrolls can be used everywhere and by all players, and are tradable.

== Clearing Imbuements ==
Each imbuement can be removed from item separately at imbuing shrine by paying gold fee of 15,000 gold. You can also use [[Etcher]] to clear all imbuements from an item.
